Sphere Bot 1.2.0

Create a team of AI bots and give each one a job. Follow conversations, computer work and returned files in one workspace.

- Meet the Gentle Curve characters, with realistic materials, expressive eyes and a choice of shapes and colours.
- Create your first bot with guided setup, example jobs and suggestions based on the tools you use.
- Connect the services your tasks need and manage their permissions from the Connectors screen.
- Personalise your workspace with organised settings for appearance, models, providers and your computer.
- Continue working on Windows or in the web app with your Sphere account.

Explore the refreshed website and getting-started guide at spherebotapp.com.
